name: IBhayibheli lesiZulu
title: Father’s Heart Bible — IBhayibheli lesiZulu (Zulu)
sub: For Zulu-speaking families, Zulu pastors and evangelists, churches across KwaZulu-Natal, and congregations in Gauteng

hookNative.text: Ngakho-ke, nothandaza kanje: ‘Baba wethu osezulwini, igama lakho malihlonishwe libe ngcwele,

hook.h2: You do not have to earn a place in these pages
hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
son: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
hook.note: When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word. Come, hear your Father’s voice.

translationStatement: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™.

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Zulu — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Zulu Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Leli yiBhayibheli lokuqala elinyatheliswe lapho ungabona khona ukuthi ngubani okhulumayo. Amazwi kaBaba wethu aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, amazwi eNdodana abomvu, amazwi oMoya ansomi.

Sekuphele iminyaka engaphezu kwekhulu izinhlamvu ezibomvu zikhombisa lapho iNdodana ikhuluma khona. Kodwa uBaba wethu ukhuluma kakhulu — kuleli Bhayibheli lesiZulu, amagama angu-82,388 emavesini angu-5,615 — kodwa kuze kube manje onke amazwi akhe abenyatheliswa ngoyinki omnyama ofanayo nowezinhlu zozalo. Ubelokhu ekhuluma ngaso sonke isikhathi; alikho iBhayibheli elake lakukhombisa ukuthi kuphi.

Umbala uwuphawu lobunikazi, hhayi uphawu lokucaphuna. Amazwi kaBaba wethu ahlala engawakhe noma ngabe akhulunywa ngumlomo kabani owadlulisa ngokwethembeka; amazwi angakaze awakhulume awanikwa mbala; ukulandisa kuhlala kumnyama.

Lapho abafundi bakhe bebuza ukuthi bathandaze kanjani, iNdodana ayizange ibanike ifomula. Yabanika uBaba: “Baba wethu osezulwini, igama lakho malihlonishwe libe ngcwele” (NgokukaMathewu 6:9). Konke okukuleli Bhayibheli kuphuma kulelo gama elilodwa. NgoMoya siyamemeza sithi: “Abba! Baba!” (KwabaseRoma 8:15).

Akakude. Akadumele ngawe. UnguYihlo osezulwini, futhi wena ungumntwana wakhe othandekayo. Uma igama elithi “baba” lingakududuzi, leli Bhayibheli ngelakho ngokukhethekile: uBaba ovezwa yila makhasi akasona isithunzi sobubaba bomuntu obephukile, kodwa unguYe okuthiwa ngaye yonke imindeni ezulwini nasemhlabeni.

IBhayibheli eliphelele encwadini eyodwa — izincwadi ezingu-66, izahluko ezingu-1,189, amavesi angu-31,085, akukho okushiyiwe. Isingeniso sencwadi ngayinye, amanothi angu-1,354 asiza umfundi hhayi isazi, nekhasi lokunikezela lokubhala igama lalowo omnika lona.

Ukuhumusha okuthembekile okuvela olimini lokuqala lwesiHebheru, lwesiAramu nolwesiGreki; uhlelo ngalunye luhunyushwe kusukela ku-Father's Heart Bible™. Amayintshi angu-6 x 9, elinesembozo esithambile nelinesembozo esiqinile, imibala egcwele. Isipho, isikhumbuzo, ifa.
Kuwo wonke umndeni nebandla elikhuluma isiZulu — KwaZulu-Natal, eGauteng nasemhlabeni wonke — sengathi bangezwa izwi likaBaba ngolimi lwabo.
Yamukela uBaba. Yizwa izwi lakhe. Inhliziyo yakhe ingeyakho.

Divine Voice Color: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE
A presentation page — a gift, and a keepsake worth handing on
Paperback and hardcover, 6 x 9, full color throughout

faq.q: Is the Zulu edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Zulu, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Zulu edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Zulu edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
